theme: Skia m150 and new filter APIs
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds image filter, color filter, and fast-bounds APIs.
highlights_body: This release lands new image-processing APIs and a performance improvement for SKSurface. It also completes the v4 breaking-change story by promoting remaining obsoletes to compile errors and removing .NET Interactive support.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: SKPaint text/font members and enum values that were marked [Obsolete] in v3 now emit compile errors in v4. Migration: switch to SKFont for text sizing and typeface assignment and remove references to the obsolete enum values.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive support removed
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks integration package has been removed. If you depend on it, pin to 4.148.x or migrate to the standard SkiaSharp NuGet package.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine is now built from chrome/m150 and includes a further upstream bug-fix sync.
The new method returns a conservative paint bounds estimate, enabling fast visibility checks without a full draw pass.
SKImageFilter gains CreateCrop() for cropping a filter chain's output and CreateEmpty() for producing transparent output.
SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() maps overdraw counts to a configurable color ramp for visualizing rendering hotspots.
Raster rendering again uses the correct blur path for small sigma values.
SKSurface now reuses its managed Canvas wrapper, avoiding repeated allocations in render loops.
The bundled text-shaping dependency is refreshed to HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Obsolete API cleanup, raster blur correction, and SKSurface canvas-wrapper caching
